name: Limit Search Criteria 7
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for a limit.

SystemIdentification.name: System Identification
SystemIdentification.definition: Identification of a particular cash clearing system.

BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.name: Bilateral Limit Counterparty Identification
BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a member within a system, assigned using the member identification scheme of the system.

DefaultLimitType.name: Default Limit Type
DefaultLimitType.definition: Type of limit as set by default in the system. The default limit is applicable by the system unless otherwise instructed.

CurrentLimitType.name: Current Limit Type
CurrentLimitType.definition: Type of limit applied by the system at the present time.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Owner of the account which is being queried.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

UsedAmount.name: Used Amount
UsedAmount.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as an amount.

UsedPercentage.name: Used Percentage
UsedPercentage.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as a percentage.

LimitCurrency.name: Limit Currency
LimitCurrency.definition: Currency unit used to specify the limit amount.

LimitAmount.name: Limit Amount
LimitAmount.definition: Amount of money of the limit, expressed in an eligible currency.

LimitValidAsOfDate.name: Limit Valid As Of Date
LimitValidAsOfDate.definition: Range of dates when the limit becomes valid.

BilateralLimitCounterparty3Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of CurrentLimitType is present and is MULT, then no occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is allowed.|If no occurrence of CurrentLimitType is MULT, then any occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is optional.|If CurrentLimitType is not present, then any occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is optional.

BilateralLimitCounterparty4Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of DefaultLimitType is present and is MULT, then no occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is allowed.|If no occurrence of DefaultLimitType is MULT, then any occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is optional.|If DefaultLimitType is not present, then any occurrence of BilateralLimitCounterpartyIdentification is optional.
